output.subject: Your online banking access since the September 6 app update
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us about your online banking access. You told us that since the app update on September 6, you have not been able to log in to your account. You mentioned that the app says it cannot verify your device, and that it sends the verification code to a phone number you no longer have. You also told us you have already changed your password three times without getting back in.

We're sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially being unable to reach your account. We understand you would like the phone number on your account updated so you can receive verification codes and use online banking again.

Our Digital Banking team will review what you have described, along with your request, and we will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you also for letting us know that you read English comfortably but explain yourself best in Spanish.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The customer wrote in Spanish. They say they read English well but express themselves better in Spanish, so decide whether to send the reply in Spanish or bilingually.
Decide how the customer can update their phone number. The draft gives no steps, so add the correct secure process.
Confirm that identity verification will be completed before any change to the phone number is made.
Check whether other customers are reporting device-verification problems after the September 6 app update.
Decide whether to offer an interim way for the customer to access their account or get support while they are locked out.
Consider whether to tell the customer that repeated password changes will not fix a verification code going to the old number.
